description.fun: Sigilyph flies the same route over the desert again and again, because its memories of guarding an ancient city have never faded; some say it was the guardians' emissary instead. Ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands where it flies. Its look draws on the bird figures of the Nazca lines and on kachina dolls, and its name joins 'sigil' and 'glyph'.
description.guide: Sigilyph is a Psychic- and Flying-type Pokémon that resembles a totem or glyph and flies by psychic power. It is said to have guarded an ancient city and always flies the same route. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: An ancient city's living glyph, still on patrol.
